---
name: Version audit document and its regeneration pipeline
description: docs/dependency-versions.md lists every plugin, version property and dependency against the repository's own maven-metadata.xml; regenerate it with the tracked scripts under docs/version-audit/.
type: reference
---

**Where:** `docs/dependency-versions.md`, generated by the tracked scripts in
`docs/version-audit/` (`step1_coords.py` → Maven reports → `step2_download.py` →
`step3_doc.py`, plus the self-checks `verify_ordering.py`, `crosscheck.py`, `qa_doc.py`).

Consult it before answering "what is the latest X", before opening a version bump, and
before deciding whether an upgrade is actually outstanding. It covers build plugins
(including plugins that declare no version and are pinned by a parent), every version
property and the coordinate each one drives, parents/BOM imports, declared dependencies
with both the pinned and the Maven-resolved version, and the full 171-coordinate
resolved closure.

**Why:** the numbers are machine-harvested rather than looked up by hand, which is the
point. Coordinates and pins are parsed from the POM bytes; latest values come from each
coordinate's own `maven-metadata.xml`, the file a Maven client itself reads; repository
roots are lifted out of Maven's own `Downloaded from <repo>:` log lines instead of being
reconstructed; every fetched file is rejected unless its inner `<groupId>/<artifactId>`
match the coordinate requested. `mvnrepository.com` and `search.maven.org` answer `403`
from this environment, so Central's `maven-metadata.xml` is the reachable authority.

**How to apply:** re-run the pipeline rather than editing the tables - the three
checkers re-derive the version ordering with a second implementation, cross-check every
"behind" verdict against the versions plugin, and fail if any harvested coordinate is
missing from the document. Two traps the document records and that recur here: a `~/.m2`
directory holding only `.lastUpdated` markers is a *failed* fetch, not a published
version (the GrowthBook SDK `0.11.1` folder is exactly this), and the `examples/`
aggregator is `-P examples` gated so default-reactor Maven runs silently omit it - ask
for `-P examples` when you need the versions a parent pins on version-less plugins.
